new_entities.name: Foam flesh of upper legform impactor
Rubber skin of upper legform impactor

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be two new sheets of 25 mm thick foam type CF-45 or equivalent, which shall be cut from the sheet of material used for the dynamic certification test
obligations.ears: For each test, the foam flesh shall be two new sheets of 25 mm thick foam type CF-45 or equivalent, which shall be cut from the sheet of material used for the dynamic certification test.

derived.text: For each test, the foam flesh shall be two new sheets of 25 mm thick foam type CF-45 or equivalent.
For each test, the foam flesh sheets shall be cut from the sheet of material used for the dynamic certification test.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: shall be a 1.5 mm thick fibre reinforced rubber sheet
obligations.ears: The skin shall be a 1.5 mm thick fibre reinforced rubber sheet.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: The mass of the foam and the rubber skin together shall be 0.6 kg ± 0.1 kg
obligations.exception: this excludes any reinforcement, mountings, etc. which are used to attach the rear edges of the rubber skin to the rear member
obligations.ears: The mass of the foam and the rubber skin together shall be 0.6 kg ± 0.1 kg (this excludes any reinforcement, mountings, etc. which are used to attach the rear edges of the rubber skin to the rear member).

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be folded back towards the rear, with the rubber skin attached via spacers to the rear member so that the sides of the rubber skin are held parallel
obligations.ears: The foam and rubber skin shall be folded back towards the rear, with the rubber skin attached via spacers to the rear member so that the sides of the rubber skin are held parallel.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be of such a size and shape that an adequate gap is maintained between the foam and components behind the front member, to avoid significant load paths between the foam and these components
obligations.ears: The foam shall be of such a size and shape that an adequate gap is maintained between the foam and components behind the front member, to avoid significant load paths between the foam and these components.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be stored during a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 per cent ± 15 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C prior to impactor removal for test
obligations.ears: Prior to impactor removal for test, the test impactor or at least the foam flesh shall be stored during a period of at least four hours in a controlled storage area with a stabilized humidity of 35 per cent ± 15 per cent and a stabilized temperature of 20 °C ± 4 °C.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area
obligations.ears: After removal from the storage, the impactor shall not be subjected to conditions other than those pertaining in the test area.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area
obligations.ears: Each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.

obligations.subject: e15
obligations.response: The selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation
obligations.ears: The selected measuring points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 2.14. of this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury
obligations.ears: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall be to different types of structure
obligations.ears: Where the types of structure vary throughout the area to be assessed, the tests shall be to different types of structure.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle
obligations.ears: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report
obligations.ears: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact
obligations.ears: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance and the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm
obligations.ears: At the time of first contact, the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance and the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.

derived.text: At the time of first contact, the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance.
At the time of first contact, the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: may verify at a sufficient number of measuring points that this condition can be met and the tests are thus being conducted with the necessary accuracy
obligations.ears: The test laboratory may verify at a sufficient number of measuring points that this condition can be met and the tests are thus being conducted with the necessary accuracy.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s
obligations.ears: When striking the bumper, the impact velocity of the upper legform impactor shall be 11.1 m/s ± 0.2 m/s.
